build_authorised_when: The claim API has verified the founder-signed delivery approval for this exact frozen specification. That approval IS the build authority: no further founder approval is needed for any build step.

build.discover: Inspect repositories, documentation and permitted runtime evidence
build.edit: Edit files inside the approved scope
build.test: Run type-check, lint, unit, integration and end-to-end tests
build.repair: Fix failures, retry with a different method, add missing tests
build.push_scoped_branch: Push the task's own feature branch
build.draft_pr: Open or update a DRAFT pull request
build.update_linear: Update Linear status and build receipts

protected_descriptions.merge: Merging any pull request or branch. On unite-group a merge to main builds a STAGED production deployment and never moves the production domain (autoAssignCustomDomains=false); promotion is a separate protected action
protected_descriptions.mark_pr_ready: Marking a pull request ready for review, or opening one that is not a draft
protected_descriptions.promote_production: Promoting, deploying, redeploying or rolling back production, or pushing directly to main
protected_descriptions.public_publish: Publishing a release or any public content
protected_descriptions.spend_expansion: Buying anything or raising any spend
protected_descriptions.destructive_action: Force-pushing, deleting branches or data, resetting history, or running migrations against any database
protected_descriptions.credential_change: Reading, adding or changing secrets and environment variables
protected_descriptions.authority_change: Changing repository settings, branch protection, workflows or permissions
protected_descriptions.strategic_scope_change: Changing the approved objective or widening the approved scope

action_classes_rule: BUILD_CONTINUE actions inside the mission's allowed actions continue with no founder question. A SAFE_RELEASE action continues only when the mission's release mandate names it, the risk is low or medium and no higher than the mandate's maxRisk, the phase is RELEASE_CANDIDATE or SAFE_RELEASE, and every safe_release_requires gate is true; otherwise it escalates as PROTECTED_RELEASE. PROTECTED_RELEASE actions always escalate. An action missing from this map escalates.

safe_release_requires.exact_final_sha: Evidence is bound to the exact final commit SHA being released
safe_release_requires.clean_tree: The working tree is clean at that SHA
safe_release_requires.required_ci_green: Every required CI check executed (none skipped) and is green for that SHA
safe_release_requires.independent_review_pass: An independent reviewer that did not build the change returned PASS for that SHA
safe_release_requires.release_gate_pass: The release gate returned PASS for that SHA
safe_release_requires.no_unresolved_p0_p1: No unresolved P0 or P1 finding remains
safe_release_requires.no_auth_security_credential_change: The change touches no authentication, security or credential surface
safe_release_requires.no_destructive_migration: The change carries no destructive database migration
safe_release_requires.no_new_spend: The change adds no new or increased spend
safe_release_requires.rollback_proven: A rollback path exists and has been exercised
safe_release_requires.post_release_verification_defined: Post-release verification is defined before the release
safe_release_requires.infrastructure_semantics_match: The target infrastructure behaves as the change assumes

interruption_classes.LEGITIMATE_PROTECTED_BOUNDARY: The next action is PROTECTED_RELEASE, or a SAFE_RELEASE action whose mandate or gates are not satisfied. The only class that justifies asking the founder.
interruption_classes.MISSING_AUTHORITY_MAPPING: The action has no class in action_classes. Fix the policy; do not ask the founder about a build step.
interruption_classes.BROKEN_TOOL: A tool, hook or script failed. Repair it and continue.
interruption_classes.MISSING_CONTEXT: The agent lacked context it could read for itself. Not a reason to interrupt.
interruption_classes.MODEL_UNCERTAINTY: The agent was unsure. Not a reason to interrupt: diagnose and continue.
interruption_classes.IMPLEMENTATION_QUESTION: An implementation choice inside the approved scope. Decide and continue.
interruption_classes.FALSE_POLICY_CONFLICT: The agent believed two rules conflicted when the policy decides it. Not a reason to interrupt.
interruption_classes.OTHER: Anything not above. Recorded so the policy can learn a class for it; still not a reason to interrupt.
